findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 3 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 67 questions numbered 1-67; by section: 3.1 5, 3.1.1 10, 3.1.2 9, 3.2 7, 3.3 5, 3.3.1 5, 3.3.2 6, 3.4 3, 3.4.1 5, 3.4.2 6, 3.5 6. Keys: {'a': 17, 'b': 17, 'c': 16, 'd': 17}.

Covers every section 3.1-3.5 in book order (quadratic function, sketching and vertex, completing the square, inverse with restricted domain, absolute value, absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities, equations reducible to quadratics, rational and radical equations, real-world problems). No exponential equations (the unit treats none). Values are changed from the book's examples and exercises; every key and distractor was checked by computation (check3_mcq.py). The printed slips (x^2 >= 4 chain, 'or' in Example 6, +2 - sqrt(1 - 0), (-3^2)) are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
